quest.title: Mr. Melancholy
quest.description: Yingzhu of the Adventurers' Guild has been having dealings with a scholar from the Sumeru Akademiya, but things seem to be going downhill, fast...
quest.rewards_formatted: Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: Hosseini, the situation is not as bad as it could be...

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: I can't believe the Irminsul Fruit exploded! My research prospects are completely ruined...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: Ah, hello Traveler. I suppose it can't hurt to tell you.

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: This gentleman's name is Hosseini. He is a researcher from the Sumeru Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: Recently, the Adventurers' Guild was commissioned by the Akademiya to investigate a ruin, where we found a perfectly preserved Irminsul Fruit.

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: The Akademiya deemed it to be a high research priority and requested that we hand it over to a scholar sent to collect it — namely, Mr. Hosseini.

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: However...

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: While transporting the Irminsul Fruit, we were ambushed by Treasure Hoarders.

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: One of them attacked the cart carrying the Irminsul Fruit and... it exploded.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Irminsul Fruits can explode?

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: Apparently so... This was also news to us when it occurred.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: My research... My thesis... My assignment from the Akademiya...

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: ...As you can see, Hosseini... very much hopes to continue with his research. To that end, he has commissioned us to search for the fragments of the Irminsul Fruit.

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, the force of the explosion sent some of the fragments into dangerous areas, where even Guild members are hesitant to venture.

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: To complicate matters further, the Irminsul Fruit attracted a lot of attention from monsters due to the great power it contains. So, some fragments were seized and taken very far away.

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: Traveler, since you are here, perhaps you would be willing to help us gather the Irminsul Fruit fragments?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure, happy to help.

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: ...Really!? That's amazing! Okay then, you'll find many <color=#00E1FFFF>places of interest</color> on your Map that we have yet to investigate.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: We've been searching non-stop for the last few days, but all we've managed to find are a few tiny <color=#00E1FFFF>bits</color>, no large fragments...

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Please help me look for more fragments. If you find any larger ones, be sure to let me know.

talks.objective: Report back to Hosseini and Yingzhu

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Have you found any fragments?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes.

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: Wow. That was quick!

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: This fragment seems a little larger than any of the previous ones we've found. Let me analyze it with the Energy Amplifier and run some numbers.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's an Energy Amplifier?

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: It's a genuine slice of ancient history! An artifact that can conduct and amplify energy. It's another object of my research.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: If you're interested, feel free to try it out for yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: Goodness... I had no idea that there were such energy-rich fragments out there. None of the other fragments we've found so far are anything like as big as this one.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: If my theory is correct, a fragment like this should have attracted a whole horde of dangerous monsters.... which begs the question: How did you manage to get your hands on it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: By defeating the monsters first.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: ...Miss Yingzhu, I regret to inform you that I shall be canceling my commission with the Adventurers' Guild with immediate effect.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Traveler... How would you like to take on a new commission?

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: Wait! You can't do that, Sumeru Akademiya signed a contract with us!

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: Ahem, and in any case — this Traveler is actually one of ours.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Oh, really? That's lucky. This is the most energy-rich fragment I've seen so far. I simply must collect some data on it.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: With this Traveler's help, my undergraduate thesis, "A Study on the Internal Energy Flow of Developing Irminsul Fruit," is saved!

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: It will be an epoch-defining study! By conducting a sequence of tests adopting a phase-wise approach, I will examine localized energy transfer and transformation within the Irminsul Fruit during a single developmental cycle, in the hope of isolating and identifying the defining features of Irminsul energetics...

response.speaker: Yingzhu
response.text: ...Please, Hosseini. We don't understand a word you are saying...

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: ...Never mind, let's move on.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Time to talk specifics. What I'd like you to do is to head to a domain that we previously discovered and conduct a practical test.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: It's a very straightforward procedure. All you need to do is place the fragments into the Energy Amplifier and take it inside with you. This will activate its energy conduction and amplification effects.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: I'll give you the Energy Amplifier now. As long as you draw energy from the Irminsul Fruit fragment while exploring the domain, I will receive data on my end.

response.speaker: Yingzhu
response.text: Traveler, no one is disputing your ability, but please be on your guard in that domain. It's extremely dangerous.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: There. It's up to you, now.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Ahem... Let's not concern ourselves with trivial details like that. Suffice to say, there are those of us at the Akademiya who are fortunate enough to undergo a... prolonged period of scrutiny by the God of Wisdom.

response.speaker: Yingzhu
response.text: I'm not educated by any description, but I think Soraya from Wangshu Inn told me something about this... "deferred graduation," isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: My data collection equipment has recorded everything. You fought sensationally.

choices.text: Mmm, I could have done better.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Very modest of you to say so. I cannot thank you enough for your phenomenal efforts in the pursuit of wisdom.

response.speaker: Yingzhu
response.text: Without you, we never would have made it inside that domain. It's just too perilous.

response.speaker: Yingzhu
response.text: You have saved the Guild's reputation from a major blow. Thank you, Traveler.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: It's a shame that the Irminsul Fruit broke into so many pieces. I can't take my research any further for the time being.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Hmm, although... maybe there's still time to change direction and focus on the Energy Amplifier in my thesis...

response.speaker: Yingzhu
response.text: My apologies once again, Mr. Hosseini. The Adventurers' Guild will not shirk our responsibility to you for this incident.

response.speaker: Yingzhu
response.text: Traveler, could I trouble you to please gather any further Irminsul Fruit fragments you come across during your travels?

response.speaker: Yingzhu
response.text: By using the Energy Amplifier to challenge domains that even I wouldn't dare enter, you will be able to provide Hosseini with further data. I have no doubt that this will be of great service to him.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Understood.

response.speaker: Yingzhu
response.text: Your support is greatly appreciated, Traveler. Safe travels, and ad astra abyssosque.

choices.text: What did you expect? I'm a champion fighter.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Haha, you certainly are, my friend, you certainly are.
